procedures.title: §11.2: VFD inverter board fault LED
procedures.purpose: Variable frequency driver board fault analysis

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before resistance checks or harness service. Restore power only for live diagnostics when required.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing electrical parts.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Mandatory diagnostic mode available (§10.5). Continue with component checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After mandatory mode entry, proceed with OEM fault-code maintenance steps.

steps.title: Locate VFD status LED
steps.body: Access compressor case VFD board (DZ120V1U inverter). Observe LED blink pattern with power applied.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Access compressor case VFD board (DZ120V1U inverter). Observe LED blink pattern with power applied.

steps.title: VFD LED blink pattern
steps.body: Match pattern: 1×0.5s/1.5s=standby; 1×0.5s/1.5s interval=overcurrent; 2×=overvoltage; 4×=undervoltage; 8×=LOCK; 16×=overload. Which fault matches?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Match pattern: 1×0.5s/1.5s=standby; 1×0.5s/1.5s interval=overcurrent; 2×=overvoltage; 4×=undervoltage; 8×=LOCK; 16×=overload. Which fault matches?
